label: prf:explicit-alpha-k-h3
title: Proof of explicit alpha k h3
html:
Proof

By spectral sequence collapse, \mathrm{HH}^k(H_3(R, q)) = 0 for k \geq 1 at generic q, so only \mathrm{HH}^0 = Z(H_3) = \bigoplus_\lambda R \cdot e_\lambda survives. Per explicit H_3 pages, the four surviving E_\infty^{p, *} classes are:

p E_\infty^{p, *} representative
0 [\mathbf{1}]
1 [\sigma_1 - \sigma_2]
2 [\sigma_1 \sigma_2 + \sigma_2 \sigma_1]
3 [\sigma_1 \sigma_2 \sigma_1] / d_2\text{-image}

The \alpha_k are extracted via the Markov-trace pairing on each class.

Jones-Markov weights. Solving the linear system \mathrm{tr}_M(\mathbf{1}) = 1, \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_i) = z, \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_i \sigma_j) = z^2 in the Wedderburn block decomposition gives unique weights y_\lambda on the three irreps \lambda \in \{(3), (2,1), (1,1,1)\}.

\alpha_0 = 1. Trivial: \mathrm{tr}_M([\mathbf{1}]) = 1 by Jones-Markov normalisation.

\alpha_1 = 0. By cyclicity of the Markov trace and equal contributions from \sigma_1, \sigma_2:

  \mathrm{tr}_M([\sigma_1 - \sigma_2])
  \;=\; \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_1) - \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_2)
  \;=\; z - z \;=\; 0.

The vanishing is exact (verified to canonical precision 10^{-16} in explicit α_k witness). An \alpha_1 value beyond zero would require a higher Hochschild operation (Gerstenhaber bracket on HH^*(H_3(R, q))) — not the direct trace pairing.

\alpha_2 = z^2. By Markov factorisation:

  \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_1 \sigma_2)
  \;=\; \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_2 \sigma_1)
  \;=\; z^2,

hence \mathrm{tr}_M([\sigma_1 \sigma_2 + \sigma_2 \sigma_1]) = 2 z^2 and \alpha_2 = 2 z^2 / 2 = z^2.

\alpha_3 = h z^2 + z. By cyclicity and the Hecke relation \sigma_1^2 = h \sigma_1 + \mathbf{1}:

  \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_1 \sigma_2 \sigma_1)
  \;=\; \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_1^2 \sigma_2)
  \;=\; h \, \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_1 \sigma_2) + \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_2)
  \;=\; h z^2 + z.

Equivalently, since hz = q^2(q^2-1)/(q^2+1) for z = q^3/(q^2+1):

  \alpha_3 \;=\; z\,(1 + hz) \;=\; \frac{q^3}{q^2+1}\Bigl(1 + \frac{q^2(q^2-1)}{q^2+1}\Bigr).

(The form z(1 + q^{1/2} - q^{-1/2}) that stood here until 2026-10-10 holds only for the excised convention-C weight z = \sqrt q/(q+1).)

\square

canonical evaluation at q_0 \approx 1.110 matches the symbolic forms above to \sim 10^{-16}; values are tabulated in the witness file (alpha-k-jones-markov-h3.witness.json).

Alternative derivation via Wenzl-bridge

By Wenzl-bridge closed form, y_\lambda(q) at H_3 admits the closed form y_\lambda = s_{\lambda, r}(Q) / \sum_\mu d_\mu s_{\mu, r}(Q) with Q = q^2 and X = Q^r = q^{3/2}/(1 + q - q^2 - q^3 + q^{3/2}). The Markov pairings \alpha_k = \langle \mathrm{tr}_M, r_k \rangle on the four E_\infty classes inherit this q-rational structure automatically; the per-class derivations below can be replaced by a uniform application of the bridge formula (see also recipe).
